backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user authentication, invoice storage, Stripe integration, usage tracking with fingerprint-based limits, event logging, and admin access control for a VAT invoice application.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two high-confidence fixes: preventing 'Cannot read property toString' errors in country selection flows and adding null safety checks to country onChange handlers.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components including calculator flow, VAT calculation logic, invoice generation, Stripe checkout, authentication, and UI components with null safety enhancements.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_SLUG.md: Documents the deployment slug 'glotaxa' with platform validation constraints (5-50 chars, alphanumeric plus hyphens) enforced at build time.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining light and dark theme color schemes using OKLCH color space for consistent design tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with meta tags, title 'Glotaxa', and script reference to the React application mounted at #root.
frontend/index.ts: Code snippet demonstrating null safety pattern for country selection onChange handler to prevent undefined crashes.
frontend/PRODUCTION_PUBLISH_V4.md: Version 39 production deployment checklist covering build preparation, deployment steps, post-deployment verification including console markers, metadata checks, and rollback procedures.
frontend/PRODUCTION_SMOKE_CHECK.md: Production smoke test runbook for Version 39 verifying console markers, route accessibility, authentication flows, Stripe checkout, and security checks for the deployed application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes for landing, calculator (with optional country search param), invoices, upgrade, and payment pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button component that uses Internet Identity for authentication, handles login errors, and clears the query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceD: Multi-field form component for entering invoice details including seller/customer info, line items with VAT categories, and displays compliance checklist and risk checks before proceeding.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceM: Displays a checklist of required invoice fields with visual indicators (checkmarks/X marks) and alerts for missing mandatory fields.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceP: Preview component that renders invoice HTML, performs validation and risk checks, and provides save/download functionality with quota enforcement and analytics logging.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceR: Modal dialog that displays deterministic risk analysis results for invoice compliance with German VAT law, showing critical issues and warnings.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main application layout with header navigation tabs (Calculator, Invoices, Upgrade), login button, and analytics logging for app opens and country detection.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeA: Admin-only component for configuring Stripe secret key and allowed countries, shown only when user is admin and Stripe is not yet configured.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeC: A button component that initiates Stripe checkout sessions for plan upgrades, logging analytics events and handling the redirect to Stripe's hosted checkout page.
frontend/src/components/usage/LimitReach: A modal dialog that appears when users hit their free plan invoice limit, prompting them to upgrade with messaging about German VAT compliance.
frontend/src/components/usage/UpgradeMod: A modal displaying Starter (€5/month) and Pro (€12/month) plan options with feature lists, allowing users to navigate to the upgrade page.
frontend/src/components/usage/UsageLimit: An alert banner that displays remaining invoice count for free plan users (5 invoices per month limit).
frontend/src/components/vat/CountrySelec: A tabbed interface for selecting business registration country from EU countries or UK, displaying country flags and VAT rates with comprehensive null-checking for country codes.
frontend/src/components/vat/CountryTrans: A comprehensive form for entering transaction details including customer type (B2B/B2C), country, VAT ID, service category, amounts, and product categories with reverse charge proof checking.
frontend/src/components/vat/CountryVatDe: Displays country-specific VAT information including standard and reduced rates, features list, and configuration status before proceeding to transaction entry.
frontend/src/components/vat/EuVatIntroSt: Displays a country selection grid for EU VAT calculation, showing flags, names, and standard rates. Validates country codes and passes the selected country to the parent component.
frontend/src/components/vat/ExplainVatPa: Shows VAT calculation explanations in two modes (standard and simple) with tabs, supporting both UK and Germany flows. Includes a Pro-gated PDF export feature with paywall dialog.
Modal dialog that blocks VAT explanation features for non-Pro users, logging upgrade CTA events and redirecting to the upgrade page.
Visual stepper component displaying progress through multi-step flows with numbered circles, check marks for completed steps, and connecting lines.
frontend/src/components/vat/GlobalDiscla: Renders a muted alert banner with a disclaimer that VAT rates vary and the tool provides estimates only, not legal or tax advice.
frontend/src/components/vat/ProductCateg: Grid of buttons for selecting product categories, supporting both standard values and exempt identifiers with visual selection state.
frontend/src/components/vat/ReverseCharg: Validates B2B cross-border VAT reverse charge eligibility by checking VAT ID format and country match, displaying results with badges and logging events.
frontend/src/components/vat/TransactionD: Form step collecting transaction details including customer type (B2C/B2B), VAT ID, product category, VAT category, and net amount with validation and navigation.
frontend/src/components/vat/uk/UkSelectC: Initial step for UK VAT calculator showing UK VAT rates (20% standard, 5% reduced, 0% zero) and registration threshold. Provides a continue button to proceed with transaction details.
frontend/src/components/vat/uk/UkTransac: Form component for UK VAT transaction input capturing transaction type, customer type, VAT category, net amount, and optional VAT ID. Includes misuse warning detection and validation with modal/inline alerts.
frontend/src/components/vat/VatCategoryI: Grid of buttons for selecting VAT categories (standard, reduced, exempt) with visual selection indicators and labels from configuration.
frontend/src/components/vat/VatResultsSt: Displays VAT calculation results with formatted amounts, classification badges, and educational notes for different VAT scenarios (reverse charge, export, exempt, etc.). Provides navigation buttons to proceed or go back.
frontend/src/config/appMeta.ts: Centralized application metadata defining display name 'Glotaxa', deployment slug, and description. Includes validation function for deployment slug format constraints.
frontend/src/config/countries.ts: Country configuration utilities defining EU, UK, and US country codes with helper functions to check country membership and determine region classification.
frontend/src/config/euVatRates.ts: Static configuration mapping EU country codes to their standard VAT rates (e.g., DE: 19%, FR: 20%, HU: 27%).
frontend/src/config/usStates.ts: Configuration for US state sales tax rates and economic nexus thresholds (revenue and transaction counts) for CA, TX, NY, FL, and WA.
frontend/src/hooks/useAccountPlan.ts: React Query hook fetching user's account plan (free/starter/pro) and monthly invoice usage from backend actor, mapping backend PlanType to frontend plan strings.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook managing backend actor creation with Internet Identity authentication, handling both authenticated and anonymous actors, and invalidating dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAnonymousUsage.ts: Hook tracking anonymous user usage count against free tier limit (5) using daily fingerprint, providing usage query and increment mutation with remaining count calculation.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCheckoutSess: Mutation hook creating Stripe checkout sessions via backend actor, validating session URLs for security, and constructing success/cancel redirect URLs.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailyFingerprint.t: Hook generating daily browser fingerprint and detecting user country from IP address, managing loading and availability states for anonymous user tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useEventLogger.ts: Hook providing event logging functionality with actor, fingerprint, and country context, wrapping core event logger with convenient interface for tracking user actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication using @dfinity/auth-client, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInvoiceNumberUniqu: Hook that checks if an invoice number already exists by calling the backend actor's doesInvoiceNumberExist method.
React Query hooks for invoice operations including listing, downloading PDFs, creating ZIP archives by selection or month, and exporting to CSV/Excel formats.
frontend/src/hooks/useInvoiceQuota.ts: Hook managing invoice quota limits based on account plan (free plan: 5/month), providing saveInvoice mutation and quota status checks.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlanAccess.ts: Hook that returns the active subscription plan (free/starter/pro) and boolean flags for plan-based feature access control.
Hook that detects and returns the browser's preferred language code, normalized to two-letter format (e.g., 'en').
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching the current user profile and checking if Stripe payment integration is configured.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color palette for light/dark themes, including green accent colors and z-index fixes for Radix UI dropdowns.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/coreEvents.ts: Defines immutable core analytics event names (app_opened, vat_calculated, payment_success, etc.) as constants for consistent tracking.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/countryDetect: Detects user's country from IP address using ipapi.co public API, returning country code and IP without persisting raw data.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/eventLogger.t: Logs analytics events to the backend actor with metadata including event name, country, page, device type, and timestamp.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/fingerprint.t: Generates GDPR-safe daily fingerprints by hashing IP + user agent + date using SHA-256, with session caching.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/buildInvoiceHtm: Builds complete HTML invoice document from invoice data and VAT calculation results, with optional German-to-English translation and VAT breakdown tables.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/currency.ts: Provides currency utilities including country-to-currency mapping via VAT table, currency formatting with Intl.NumberFormat, and symbol extraction.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/deriveInvoiceVa: Derives invoice VAT outcome (rate, amount, label, currency) from VAT calculation results, prioritizing cross-border treatment labels and mapping scenarios to canonical display labels.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/getAutoLegalVat: Auto-generates professional legal VAT text for invoices based on scenario and seller country, prioritizing cross-border treatment wording when applicable.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/getInvoiceWordi: Provides country-specific invoice wording for VAT scenarios (reverse charge, exempt, zero-rated, reduced, standard) with fallback to generic text.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/invoiceLineItem: Defines invoice line item data structures and provides functions to calculate line item totals, aggregate invoice totals, and group items by VAT rate.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/invoiceVatCateg: Provides VAT category logic for invoice line items, including note generation for reduced rates and special scenarios, and aggregation of invoice notes.
Defines country-specific invoice wording for reverse charge and exempt scenarios across multiple EU countries and UK, with fallback to generic EU VAT Directive text.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/riskCheck.ts: Performs comprehensive invoice risk checks including mandatory field validation, legal VAT text requirements, reverse charge proof validation, and date/format warnings.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/validateInvoice: Provides comprehensive invoice compliance validation including supplier, customer, invoice identification checks, and VAT number format validation with blocking/non-blocking error classification.
Validates mandatory invoice fields (supplier info, invoice number/date, line items, totals) and scenario-specific requirements like legal VAT text, returning detailed check results.
frontend/src/lib/production/productionMa: Logs a production build marker (v39) to the console for deployment verification, only in production mode.
frontend/src/lib/translation/deToEn.ts: Provides deterministic offline German-to-English translation using a fixed dictionary for invoice fields, preserving capitalization and punctuation.
frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateUkVat.ts: Calculates UK VAT based on transaction type (goods export, service to EU business, domestic) applying zero-rated, reverse charge, or standard/reduced rates.
frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateUnifiedVat: Smart VAT engine that determines cross-border VAT treatment based on country pairs and transaction type, then computes VAT accordingly using existing helpers.
frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateVat.ts: Defines VAT calculation input/result types and provides calculateEUVAT and calculateGermanyVAT functions handling reverse charge, exempt, and standard/reduced rates.
frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateVatAmounts: Helper function that calculates VAT amount and total from net amount and rate using the formula: vatAmount = netAmount * rate / 100.
frontend/src/lib/vat/categoryEligibility: Defines product category lists for exempt, UK zero-rated, UK reduced, and EU reduced rates with normalized identifier matching for eligibility checks.
frontend/src/lib/vat/deriveVatRatePercen: Derives the VAT rate percentage for backend from UI state (country, category, treatment, reverse charge) using existing VAT helpers.
frontend/src/lib/vat/determineCrossBorde: Determines cross-border VAT treatment (domestic, intra-EU supply, reverse charge, export, EU B2C) based on seller/customer countries, customer type, and VAT ID validity.
frontend/src/lib/vat/determineVatRate.ts: VAT rate decision engine implementing priority flow: reverse charge (0%), explicit reduced rate selection, or category-based rate computed from country config.
frontend/src/lib/vat/euCountryConfig.ts: Provides country configuration lookup with UK/GB normalization, exports EU country configs list, and defines COUNTRY_LIST constant for all supported countries.
frontend/src/lib/vat/explainUkVat.ts: Generates detailed UK-specific VAT explanations for different scenarios including domestic, export zero-rated, reverse charge, and exempt supplies.
frontend/src/lib/vat/explainVat.ts: Generates detailed VAT explanations for German VAT scenarios including Kleinunternehmer exemption, reverse charge, VAT exemption, digital B2C EU, and intra-EU supply rules.
Provides simplified, plain-language explanations of German VAT scenarios using everyday analogies and simple terms for non-technical users.
frontend/src/lib/vat/germanyVatRateHisto: Manages historical German VAT rates including COVID-19 temporary reduction period, with functions to retrieve rates for specific dates and check historical differences.
frontend/src/lib/vat/identifierNormaliza: Provides identifier normalization utilities to ensure consistent eligibility checks by converting identifiers to lowercase, trimming whitespace, and standardizing separators.
frontend/src/lib/vat/index.ts: Barrel export file that re-exports all VAT-related modules and selectively exports specific items from determineCrossBorderVAT to avoid type conflicts.
frontend/src/lib/vat/isZeroVatResult.ts: Helper function to identify zero-VAT scenarios (UK export zero-rated or explicit 0% rate) used by invoice line-item editor to lock VAT rate.
frontend/src/lib/vat/ossIndicator.ts: Checks OSS (One-Stop-Shop) relevance for digital/SaaS B2C cross-border EU transactions and provides explanatory reasons.
frontend/src/lib/vat/productCategoryOpti: Defines product category dropdown options for VAT engine including basic food, books, medical, transport, hotel, financial services, and UK-specific categories with country-based filtering.
frontend/src/lib/vat/promptFlowGermany.t: Defines system prompt and screen-by-screen flow prompts for German VAT calculation engine covering country selection, transaction details, calculation logic, invoice generation, and upgrade paths.
Defines product categories eligible for reduced VAT rates per country (EU common categories and UK-specific 5%/0% rates) and provides functions to check eligibility and retrieve the appropriate reduced rate.
frontend/src/lib/vat/region.ts: Defines region types (EU, UK, USA, APAC) with support status, and provides utilities to normalize country codes, detect regions from country codes, and check if a region is supported.
frontend/src/lib/vat/selectedSellerCount: Provides helper functions to safely read, validate, and set seller country codes from URL search parameters with comprehensive null/undefined checks and format validation.
frontend/src/lib/vat/toBackendVatCalcula: Maps calculator form state to backend VatCalculation payload, deriving VAT rate percentages and converting category names to backend enum format.
frontend/src/lib/vat/ukMisuseWarnings.ts: Checks for UK VAT misuse patterns (e.g., reduced rate for consulting, zero rate for software) and returns appropriate warning messages with modal display flags.
frontend/src/lib/vat/ukTypes.ts: Defines UK-specific types for VAT calculations including transaction types, customer types, VAT categories (standard/reduced/zero/exempt), and result structures.
frontend/src/lib/vat/validateReverseChar: Validates reverse charge eligibility for B2B cross-border transactions by checking VAT ID format and verifying the VAT ID country prefix matches the customer country.
frontend/src/lib/vat/vatCategoryRateRule: Defines VAT categories (standard, reduced, zero, exempt, etc.) and computes country-specific VAT rates based on category eligibility rules for DE, FR, IT, SE, BE, ES, and GB.
frontend/src/lib/vat/vatConfig.ts: Defines standard, reduced, and zero VAT rates for all supported countries (DE, FR, NL, PL, SE, IT, BE, AT, HU, ES, GB) in a simple configuration object.
frontend/src/lib/vat/vatResultBuilder.ts: Provides a utility function to build canonical VAT result objects containing rate, VAT amount, total, and label from net amount and rate inputs.
frontend/src/lib/vat/vatTable.ts: Central VAT configuration table mapping country codes to detailed VAT information including standard/reduced rates, currency, flag emoji, invoice labels, and configuration status.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers, then renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/CalculatorFlowPage.ts: Main calculator flow page managing multi-step VAT calculation workflow (country selection, transaction details, results, explanation, invoice creation) with state management and navigation between steps.
frontend/src/pages/InvoicesPage.tsx: Invoice management page displaying list of invoices with features for batch operations (PDF download, ZIP export, CSV/Excel export) and plan-gated premium features with upgrade prompts.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page with hero section, feature highlights, and quick country selection for EU and UK regions to start VAT calculations.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Payment failure page displaying error message with options to retry payment or return home.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Payment success confirmation page that logs analytics events, invalidates plan cache, and provides navigation to calculator or invoices.
frontend/src/pages/UpgradePage.tsx: Subscription upgrade page displaying Free, Starter, and Pro plan tiers with Stripe checkout integration and authentication requirements.
frontend/src/tax/euVatEngine.ts: EU VAT calculation engine implementing domestic VAT, cross-border B2B reverse charge, B2C OSS destination VAT, and digital services VAT rules.
frontend/src/tax/taxRouter.ts: Global tax routing logic that delegates to appropriate regional tax engine (EU, UK, or US) based on seller country.
frontend/src/tax/ukVatEngine.ts: UK VAT calculation engine implementing domestic VAT at 20% standard rate, export zero-rating, and import VAT handling.
frontend/src/tax/usSalesTaxEngine.ts: Calculates US sales tax based on economic nexus thresholds (revenue and transaction counts) and destination-based tax rates by state.
frontend/src/types/taxTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript types for tax calculations including Region, CustomerType, ProductType, and TaxInput interface with seller/buyer details.
frontend/src/utils/downloadFile.ts: Utility function to trigger browser downloads for both text (CSV) and binary (PDF, ZIP, Excel) content using Blob and URL.createObjectURL.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended theme properties, animations, and plugins for typography and container queries.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite build configuration for React app with environment variable injection, path aliases, proxy setup for local API, and optimized build settings.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking a fix request for a 'Cannot read property toString' error occurring during country selection, with two related feature fixes defined.
